name: Devyani International Ltd
title: Devyani International Ltd - 543330 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: QSR operator with KFC SSSG +4.9% and brand contribution up ~20%, but Pizza Hut SSSG -3.7% and net store closures in Q4 leave supply discipline and pricing unproven; no capex-per-store change guided.

triggers.label: KFC SSSG +4.9%, strongest in 14 quarters
triggers.quote: KFC delivered its strongest performance in the last 14 quarters, posting 4.9% positive SSSG and nearly 15% year -on-year growth during the quarter.

triggers.label: Q4 net store count negative; closures
triggers.quote: you have seen negative numbers in Q4, which is primarily because we are resetting our strategy from a BD perspective in terms of better -quality stores and a better pipeline.

triggers.label: Pizza Hut SSSG -3.7%
triggers.quote: While SSSG was at minus 3.7%, the SSSG performance improved on a sequential basis

triggers.label: Menu price change under 0.5pp
triggers.quote: on a portfolio basis, I would say it was maybe less than 0.5 percentage point.

guidance.quote: We expect to add approximately 200 to 225 net new stores in FY27 as DIL.
KFC is expected to contribute 100 to 110 stores of these additions

guidance.value: by end of current fiscal year
guidance.quote: We continue to expect completion of the merger by end of the current financial year.

red_flags.label: Pizza Hut SSSG negative, brand contribution slightly negative
red_flags.quote: Brand contribution for the quarter was slightly negative, primarily due to operating deleverage arising from lower same-store sales.

red_flags.label: Store closures; negative Q4 net adds
red_flags.quote: the focus, as you said, is to kind of shut the loss-making stores, which are there in the portfolio

red_flags.label: Debt up; temporary borrowing for Thailand equity
red_flags.quote: we raised some debt because there was some equity infusion required in Thailand

evasions.quote: If you can help me foresee the inflation in the near future, I will be able to tell you that.

evasions.topic: KFC SSSG drivers split (macro vs own initiatives)
evasions.quote: it is difficult to quantify factor by factor, as I have said in the past.
Mumbai question, you need to check with Sapphire.

summary.headline: Devyani Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue rose 18.5% YoY to INR 1,437 crore, with KFC SSSG at 4.9%, its best in 14 quarters.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue grew 18.5% YoY to INR 1,437 crore, and FY26 revenue crossed INR 5,500 crore at INR 5,611 crore. KFC returned to positive SSSG of 4.9% with nearly 15% YoY revenue growth, driven by a shift in focus to dine-in customers and store-level deals. Pizza Hut SSSG stayed negative at -3.7% and brand contribution was slightly negative, while the international business grew 20% YoY. Management is pursuing the Sapphire Foods merger, targeting completion by end of FY27, and is rebuilding the leadership team. Store count was 2,256 at year end, with negative net additions in Q4.

financial_highlights.change: Crossed INR 5,500 crore milestone; YoY change not stated

financial_highlights.value: Crossed INR 500 crore; brand contribution INR 89 crore at 17.7% margin

financial_highlights.change: Gross margin down 1.2% YoY on coffee and cocoa costs

segments.name: KFC
segments.commentary: Q4 SSSG +4.9%, revenue INR 586 crore (+~15% YoY), brand contribution INR 99 crore at 17.0% margin; 783 stores in India. Over 80% digital kiosk penetration across the KFC network.

segments.name: Pizza Hut
segments.commentary: SSSG -3.7% with sequential improvement; ADS stable at ~INR 30,000 per store per day; brand contribution slightly negative on deleverage; 639 stores, no net additions in Q4 and none planned for calendar 2026.

segments.name: Franchise Brands (incl. Costa Coffee)
segments.commentary: Revenue up nearly 3% YoY; gross margin down 1.2% YoY on elevated coffee and cocoa prices; brand contribution margin 16.1%.

segments.name: Own brands (Vaango, Biryani By Kilo)
segments.commentary: Both brands reported mid-single-digit positive SSSG. Biryani By Kilo reached positive brand contribution and is being tested in Express formats in food courts, which management says have been profitable.

segments.name: International (Nepal, Thailand)
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 20% YoY, crossing INR 500 crore in a quarter for the first time; Nepal +46% and Thailand +19%. Tea Live is being discontinued after testing in India and Thailand.

guidance_outlook: FY27 store additions of about 200 to 225 net new stores on a standalone basis, with KFC contributing 100 to 110 and the rest from Costa, Biryani By Kilo, Vaango and international.
No net new Pizza Hut stores planned for calendar 2026; portfolio consolidation continues.
Sapphire Foods merger expected to complete by end of current fiscal year (FY27); exchange approval expected shortly, followed by CCI application.
Tech and AI initiatives to be funded within existing budgets, including payments to Yum!; no change to store size or capex per store planned.
Management expects it will take a couple more quarters to confirm that the worst is behind for KFC; current SSSG trend maintained for about 45 days of Q1 FY27.
Analyst Day proposed within the next couple of quarters for brand-by-brand plans once the new leadership team is in place.
capex_capacity: Q4 FY26 store count was negative as the company reset its business development strategy toward better-quality stores and a better pipeline; closures of loss-making stores are underway.
Year-end system store count of 2,256, a net addition of 217 over the last 12 months.
Biryani By Kilo express formats being tested in food courts; management says these have been profitable.
Gas crisis prompted switch to electrical equipment at Biryani By Kilo; evaluating dual gas/electric equipment across the portfolio.
demand_pricing: KFC SSSG recovery attributed to a shift of promotions from online to dine-in, with best deals offered at store level; online SSSG fell but offline growth more than offset it.
Menu price correction at KFC below 0.5 percentage point on a portfolio basis; no further price increases planned to be disclosed.
KFC gross margin expanded on favourable raw and packing material costs and deal restructuring.
Ticket growth and AOV both contributed to KFC SSSG; management is working to win back lapsed customers while recruiting new ones.

Gas supply crisis from the Middle East conflict had minimal impact on operations, though it persists in parts of the country; gas cost described as a small share of sales (exact figure not disclosed).

qa_highlights.question: How do the leadership changes (CTO, CMO, COO) support growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management hired Neeraj Tiwari as CTO, Sandeep Anand as CMO (also overseeing Pizza Hut operations), and announced a COO from FMCG and technology backgrounds who joins in the next couple of weeks. Other appointments cover Costa and smaller brands. The aim is in-house technology capability and operational transformation.

qa_highlights.question: Are the store closures a deliberate clean-up, and does guidance change?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the Q4 negative store count reflects a reset in BD strategy toward better-quality stores and shutting loss-making units. FY27 guidance of 200 to 225 net additions, including 110 to 120 KFC, is unchanged.

qa_highlights.question: How much of KFC's SSSG is macro versus company initiatives, and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is hard to quantify and that SSSG was maintained for about 45 days of Q1 FY27. It said it will take a couple more quarters to confirm the trend.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the KFC gross margin expansion and SSSG?
qa_highlights.answer: Favourable raw and packing material costs, deal restructuring favouring dine-in, and a shift of promotions from online to offline. Menu price correction was below 0.5 percentage point.

qa_highlights.question: Split of KFC SSSG between AOV and transactions; Pizza Hut revival timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Both ticket and AOV contributed. Pizza Hut is being revisited on product, pricing layers and quality, with a launch expected in roughly a couple of months. An Analyst Day is proposed in the next couple of quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Biryani By Kilo profitability and debt and intangibles increase in FY26?
qa_highlights.answer: Biryani By Kilo moved from loss-making to positive brand contribution. Intangible increase is mainly from the Biryani By Kilo consolidation (goodwill and brands). Debt was raised temporarily for Thailand equity infusion and was squared off by mid-April.

risks_watch: Pizza Hut remains at -3.7% SSSG with no net store additions planned for calendar 2026.
Sustainability of KFC's SSSG recovery, which management says needs a couple more quarters of evidence.
Gas supply disruption continues in parts of India; mitigation is through equipment changes.
Coffee and cocoa costs pressuring Costa gross margin (down 1.2% YoY).
Sapphire Foods merger approvals (exchange, then CCI) and leadership team build-out; new team to be largely in place by next quarter.
Q4 negative net store count; watch whether FY27 additions of 200 to 225 materialise.
summary.management_tone: Confident on KFC momentum and the merger timeline, but cautious on sustainability, with management repeatedly saying it is too early to call the trend and that macro conditions are not controllable. Evasive on the exact split of KFC SSSG between AOV and transactions, and on gas cost and price-increase plans.
key_quotes: KFC delivered a positive SSSG of 4.9% for the quarter, the strongest performance in the last 14 quarters, reaffirming both the resilience of the brand and the long-term opportunity in the market.
Obviously, it will take another couple of quarters by the time we are firmly able to say that the worst is behind us.
Mumbai territory is with Sapphire, not with us.

adds.what: KFC net new stores FY27 (100 to 110 stores)
DIL standalone net new stores FY27 (200 to 225 total, incl. KFC, Costa, Biryani By Kilo, Vaango, international)

growth.why: Management guides 200 to 225 net new DIL standalone stores in FY27 (KFC 100 to 110), with store-level execution backing it, but no revenue growth % is guided, Pizza Hut has no net additions planned for calendar 2026, and Q4 net store count was negative as closures of loss-making stores proceed.

mgmt.note: Management is rebuilding the leadership team; new Analyst Day proposed once the new leadership is in place, but no named new top executive or stated growth plan in the brief.
